local_facts.claim: Virginia Beach General District Court has a $50,000 jurisdictional limit for personal-injury and wrongful-death claims. Virginia Beach is an independent city with its own local court system.
local_facts.why_it_matters: The amount sought can affect whether the case may be heard in General District Court or requires a Circuit Court analysis. The city is not sitting in a county court system, so the court and filing path need to be matched to the specific matter.
local_facts.title: Virginia Beach has its own court path and a $50,000 injury-claim limit

local_facts.claim: NAS Oceana, in Virginia Beach, is the Navy's East Coast Master Jet Base and includes Dam Neck Annex and Naval Auxiliary Landing Field Fentress. The installation reports about 10,500 active Navy personnel, 10,000 family members and 4,500 civilian personnel.
local_facts.why_it_matters: An injury involving a service member, federal employee, contractor, government equipment or military property may need a different first review from an ordinary Virginia private-party claim. Precise details about the person, place and activity can determine whether a federal administrative process is relevant.
local_facts.title: A military or federal connection can change the first question

local_facts.claim: Virginia Beach's Oceanfront District includes a three-mile boardwalk, the Atlantic and Pacific Avenue beach-related corridors, and more than 40 beachfront hotels and resorts.
local_facts.why_it_matters: A fall or other injury near the Oceanfront can involve a hotel, restaurant, parking area, beach access, public walkway or another adjoining area. A precise location is essential for identifying who controlled the condition and what records or video may exist.
local_facts.title: The Oceanfront is a dense resort setting, not one property

anchors.label: Filing civil papers, Virginia Beach General District Court
anchors.detail: The clerk's published cost to file civil papers, including a warrant in debt. The total varies with the amount in controversy.
anchors.source_name: Virginia Beach General District Court, Civil Division fees

anchors.label: Injury or wrongful death claim a district court may hear
anchors.detail: Below $4,500 the district court has exclusive original jurisdiction; between that and fifty thousand dollars it shares jurisdiction with the circuit court.

anchors.label: Maximum percentage the Commonwealth sets for injury work
anchors.detail: Virginia opens its fee rule with the requirement that a fee be reasonable and then lists eight factors. No percentage appears in the rule.
anchors.source_name: Va. Rules of Prof. Conduct, Rule 1.5(a)

anchors.label: Window for written notice of an attorney's lien
anchors.detail: A lien attaches to a tort cause of action on contracting, but written notice must reach the client, the other side and the clerk within that window or before settlement.

fee_rows.stage: Statutory share of a district court civil filing
fee_rows.note: The fee set by statute for court and magistrate services on a civil warrant or garnishment, of which ten dollars funds court technology.
Twelve dollars to serve civil process on one person, firm or corporation. Papers returnable outside Virginia cost seventy-five.

fee_rows.stage: What a contingent agreement must state in writing
fee_rows.note: How the fee is computed, the percentages on settlement, trial and appeal, the expenses deducted, and whether they come out before or after the fee.
fee_rows.source_name: Va. Rules of Prof. Conduct, Rule 1.5(c)

fee_rows.stage: Matters where a contingent fee is off limits
fee_rows.note: Domestic relations work, except in rare instances, and the defense of a criminal case. An injury claim sits outside both.
fee_rows.source_name: Va. Rules of Prof. Conduct, Rule 1.5(d)

fee_rows.stage: Medical malpractice, a limit on the verdict
fee_rows.note: Virginia's sliding statutory ceiling on the total recoverable from a health care provider climbs to three million dollars for acts after June 2031.
